new_assertions.body: An exact Q,D pair already exists with Q=q_o and D=rank-well-founded Bellman evaluation on standard 7x6; existence is not the unresolved question.

A future-derived recursive equivalence class may be used as a compression oracle but is inadmissible as the final rank-local definition of Q unless an equivalent current-rank structural recognizer is found.
The complete 4x4 controls establish strict rank-local Q-F compressions below q_o using remaining-capacity, support-release and frontier deletions.
The 4x4 final-cap and all-closure candidates separate value/action-value sufficiency from complete future-transition sufficiency.
Physical-board automorphism and compiled-q transition-algebra automorphism are distinct symmetry notions; arbitrary column permutation can fail the first while satisfying the second.
If the symbolic q_o column-permutation equivariance proof qualifies generally, the S_W orbit q_Sigma is a direct rank-local transporter-aware Q-F quotient and a scalar Q-V quotient.
